title: Bhai Shabbir ka haider ka pisar
body:
Bhai Shabbir ka haider ka pisar
(Abbas hai Abbas, Abbas hai Abbas, Abbas hai Abbas, hai hai abbas) x2
(Bhai shabbir ka, Haider ka piser aata hai)
(Jang karne bani hasham) x2 ka kamar aata hai
bhai shabbir.
Aysa tanha ko bahadur koi dekha na suna (Abbas hai Abbas) x3
Aysa tanha ko bahadur (koi dekha na suna) x2
Zaat me apni jo, lashkar sa nazar aata hai
<<MINI>>
Jang karne.
<<DIVIDER>>
Yaad aati hai sakina ki bari kalb ke sath (Abbas hai abbas) x3
Yaad aati hai sakina ki (bari kalb ke sath) x2
Name abbas ka hoto pe agar aata hai
<<MINI>>
Jang karne.
<<DIVIDER>>
Khoon bhara aaya alam ro ke ye zainab ne kahaa (Abbas hai abbas) x3
Khoon bhara aaya alam ro ke (ye zainab ne kahaa) x2
Bhayi tum aye nahi moo ko jigar aata hai
<<MINI>>
Jang karne.
<<DIVIDER>>
Door se apka alam dekh ke bachi boli (Abbas hai abbas) x3
Door se apka alam dekh (ke bachi boli) x2
Dekho darya ke chacha lot ke gar ataa hai
<<MINI>>
Jang karne..
<<DIVIDER>>
Sharm se rukta nahi neze pe abbas ka sar (abbas hai abbas) x3
Sharm se rukta nahi neze pe (abbas ka sar)x2
Beridaa kumba jo gazi ko nazar aata hai
<<MINI>>
Jang karne..
<<DIVIDER>>
Hote zainab ke madad ake karo ai bhai (abbas hai abbas)x3
Hote zainab ke madad ake (karo ai bhai) x2
Awo abbas ke zinddan ka gar aata hai
<<MINI>>
Jang karne.
<<DIVIDER>>
Nawha parta hai hasan kat ke kurbal rehaan (abbas hai abbas)x3
Nawha parta hai hasan kat ke (kurbal rehaan)x2
Hai duwa gazi ki kisko ye hunar aata hai
<<MINI>>
Jang karne..
